BiblicalUsage: The Preacher gave good heed and sought out and set in order many proverbs, and weighed the words of the wise. One word for pondering — weighing wisdom the way a merchant weighs silver.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wisdom is worth weighing carefully, and the Preacher is my model: he did not just speak proverbs, he sought them out and set them in order.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
